title: Set Receipt
user: Regular lifters who want to record a set as quickly as writing 225x5 in a notebook and retain a compact proof of the workout.
smallest_useful_product: Offline PWA with a text grammar for sets, editable exercise aliases, rest timer, and a shareable/printable receipt containing volume, duration, and PRs.
constraints: Local and exportable data; accessible, gym-sized controls; no training or injury advice.
